familyContent.seoTitle: Topaz Gigapixel API — Photo Upscaling & Transparent PNG
familyContent.seoDescription: Enlarge photos and artwork to 2K, 4K or 8K with twelve Topaz presets. Rebuild soft faces with Wonder 4 or preserve alpha in transparent PNGs.

faq.question: Will Standard V2 make a badly blurred face sharp?
faq.answer: In our defocused portrait it enlarged the blur. Wonder 4 reconstructed clearer eyes and facial detail, but generated detail should always be checked.

faq.question: Are 2K, 4K and 8K fixed edge lengths?
faq.answer: These are approximate pixel-area tiers: 4, 16.8 and 67 MP. Our 1100×900 source returned at 2264×1852 on the 2K tier.

faq.question: What changes the charge?
faq.answer: The preset and resolution tier determine the per-image charge. Output format does not affect it; 8K is the most expensive tier for each preset.

data.description:
## Gigapixel enlargement

Gigapixel offers faithful enlargement and generative reconstruction through a single preset choice. The default is `standard_v2`.

## Request settings

Send `image_url`, choose `preset` and select `resolution` from `2k`, `4k` or `8k` (default `4k`). JPEG is the default output.

## Delivery constraints

For transparent artwork use `preset: transparent` together with `output_format: png`. Review generated facial details before using the enlarged image.

paramNotes.image_url: The single JPEG, PNG or WebP source that Gigapixel will enlarge.
paramNotes.output_format: Gigapixel normally returns `jpeg`; `png` is also available at the same price. The `transparent` preset accepts only `png`.
paramNotes.preset: Choose among twelve models. The five precision presets preserve content; generative presets reconstruct details. `transparent` is dedicated to alpha-preserving PNGs.
paramNotes.resolution: `2k`, `4k` (default) or `8k` selects approximately 4, 16.8 or 67 MP while retaining proportions. The tier also affects billing.

image_url.description: The image to enlarge: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Framing and aspect ratio are kept; only the pixel count goes up. Use a PNG with an alpha channel for the transparent preset.

output_format.description: File type of the returned image. png avoids another round of lossy compression but is several times larger. The format does not change the price.

preset.description: Which Topaz Gigapixel model to run. Precise presets enlarge without inventing content: standard_v2 (general photos), high_fidelity_v3 (already sharp, high-resolution sources), low_resolution_v2 (small or heavily compressed images), cgi (illustrations and renders), text_refine (text, logos and graphics). Generative presets rebuild detail and cost more: wonder_4 (all-purpose enhancement), wonder_3_5, recover_3 (badly degraded photos), standard_max, redefine (adds new detail) and detail (realistic skin and faces in AI images). transparent enlarges a PNG while keeping its alpha channel and always returns PNG.

resolution.description: Output size: a pixel budget of about 4 MP (2k), 16.8 MP (4k) or 67 MP (8k) with the source aspect ratio kept. The price depends on this tier and the preset.

data.pricingNote: Gigapixel is billed per completed image according to `preset` and `resolution`. Changing `output_format` does not change the charge.
data.readme:
## Gigapixel enlargement

Run one Gigapixel preset on a photo or graphic and receive an enlarged result in the selected pixel-area tier; transparent artwork is returned as PNG.

## Request settings

```json
{
  "image_url": "https://example.com/blurred-portrait.jpg",
  "preset": "standard_v2",
  "resolution": "2k",
  "output_format": "jpeg"
}
```

## Preset guide

| `preset` | Best starting point |
|---|---|
| `standard_v2` | General photos; default precision option |
| `high_fidelity_v3` | Already sharp, high-resolution material |
| `low_resolution_v2` | Tiny or heavily compressed images |
| `cgi` | Illustrations and rendered artwork |
| `text_refine` | Text, logos and graphics |
| `wonder_4` | Latest all-purpose generative enhancement |
| `wonder_3_5` | Generative reconstruction with Wonder 3.5 |
| `recover_3` | Severely degraded photographs |
| `standard_max` | Generative detail reconstruction |
| `redefine` | Adds new detail and may change likeness |
| `detail` | More realistic skin in AI-generated faces |
| `transparent` | Alpha-preserving PNG enlargement |

## Observed results

From left: source, Standard V2, Wonder 4. The precision result stays soft around the eyes; Wonder 4 rebuilds a more defined face while keeping its overall likeness in this test.

Redefine made this man look younger and changed his features. Recover 3 and Standard MAX also rebuilt facial detail; Detail left this severely defocused face softer. These are observations from one image, not promises for every photo.

Our cutout yellow-orange rose PNG grew from 400×301 to 2360×1776 with its alpha channel intact. Its pink petal tips carry water droplets, with a short green stem and leaves also visible. The dark comparison backdrop is for display only; the example file retains transparency.

## Delivery constraints

A request handles one image with one preset. Generative presets can alter faces and small details, so they are unsuitable for identity documents or evidentiary restoration. An 8K result can be a large download. Choosing JPEG with `transparent` is rejected.

examples.note: Wonder 4, 2K: our severely defocused bar portrait gained clearer facial detail at 2264×1852.
Standard V2, 2K: this 2264×1852 result shows why enlargement alone may leave an unfocused face blurry.
Transparent, 2K: the cutout rose grew from 400×301 to 2360×1776 with alpha preserved; PNG output is required.
